channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Agreement reached: Gotliv to leave Likud for Ben-Gvir
item.description: Likud and Tally Gotliv reach agreement allowing her to run with Otzma Yehudit while requiring her to vote with Likud until the next Knesset is sworn in.

item.title: The Durban strategy and the campaign to isolate Israel
item.description: By hijacking an anti-racism agenda for its own antisemitic goals, the Durban summit sought to delegitimize a sovereign state and rationalize terrorist violence. Opinion.

item.title: Minute by minute: Netanyahu reveals what the morning of October 7 looked like
item.description: Following what it described as “inaccurate reports," the Prime Minister’s Office publishes the sequence of events on the morning of October 7 - minute by minute.

item.title: Ben-Gvir unveils ‘Disengagement 710’ program demand: ‘Time to pack suitcases’
item.description: Ben-Gvir unveils ‘Disengagement 710,’ proposing a new ministry and billions in funding to encourage voluntary emigration from Gaza.

item.title: Netanyahu to IDF brass: Iran regime change is Israel’s ‘main task’
item.description: Netanyahu tells IDF generals Iran's regime is weaker than ever, declaring that toppling it is Israel's main remaining mission and is 'within arm's reach.'

item.title: Zamir: IDF’s new doctrine is clear - ‘No ignoring, no containment’
item.description: IDF Chief Eyal Zamir calls for expanding the military and broadening the pool of those serving, while pledging greater support for troops and reservists.

item.title: Crisis in Givati deepens: Parents step in
item.description: The parents of soldiers in the Rotem Battalion sent a sharply worded letter to IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir under the headline “Crisis of Confidence and Command Failure."

item.title: Kickboxer with SS tattoo makes Nazi salute after beating Jew
item.description: Former felon makes Nazi salute to fans carrying Nazi flag after narrow by-decision victory over Jewish opponent.

item.title: PMO: Release of Lebanese detainees tied to search for slain Jewish leaders
item.description: PMO stresses the five Lebanese detainees are not terrorists, says their release comes amid efforts to recover the bodies of murdered Jewish community leaders.

item.title: Rabbi Levanon: Halachically permissible to vote for Yoseph Haddad
item.description: הרב אליקים לבנון מתייחס לדברי הרב אבינר: "אפשר להצביע גם עבור אלה באומות העולם שתומכים בעמדתנו"

item.title: 'Done being passive' | Smotrich’s response to European boycott
item.description: The Finance Minister responded during a meeting with industrialists in Ma’ale Adumim to threats of sanctions from Britain and other countries. “One market closes? Other markets will open."

item.title: AIsraeli Consul General praises woman who confronted Mamdani
item.description:
Israeli Consul General in New York City Ofir Akunis praised the Jewish woman who confronted Mayor Zohran Mamdani during his visit to Borough Park.
"Stephanie Ben-Shimol told the truth to New York City Mayor, Mamdani. He hates Israel, the Jewish state, and since he took office, hate crimes against Jews have skyrocketed. In almost every one of his appearances, he incites and spreads hatred against Israel, thereby encouraging his violent supporters to harm Jews and Israelis in New York," Akunis stated.

item.title: Yair Golan on Cafe's decision to close on Shabbat: 'The result of haredi terrorism'
item.description:
Democrats Party chairman Yair Golan responded to the decision by Jerusalem’s Cafe Basimta to close on Saturdays following haredi protests outside the establishment.
“This is the result of haredi terrorism. Cafe Basimta sought to do something simple: open on Shabbat in Jerusalem. It did not force anyone to violate Shabbat or change anyone’s way of life. It merely allowed those who chose to do so to drink coffee on Shabbat in their own city.
“For weeks, the cafe was subjected to terror, violence, demonstrations and threats, until it gave in and decided to close. This is what coercion looks like. If we do not stop it, it will spread to the next cafe."

item.title: Shabbat showdown ends: Jews for Jesus cafe to close on Saturdays
item.description: Cafe Basimta announces it will close on Shabbat after two months of clashes with haredi protesters over its Saturday operations and missionary ties.

item.title: NYPD: Jump in antisemitic crimes fuels surge in hate crimes
item.description: Ahead of Rosh Hashanah, the NYPD reveals that hate crimes are up nearly 16% in Mamdani's first year, with anti-Jewish hate crimes making up the majority.

item.title: Ben-Gvir claims: Netanyahu offered me to be Foreign Minister
item.description: Ben-Gvir says Netanyahu offered him the Foreign Ministry during coalition talks, jokes about hosting diplomats in Hebron and sets his sights on a senior post.

item.title: Second time today: IDF eliminates terrorists crossing Yellow Line in Gaza
item.description:
Earlier today (Thursday), IDF troops operating in the northern Gaza Strip identified two terrorists who crossed the Yellow Line and approached the troops in a manner that posed an immediate threat.
Following the identification, the troops eliminated the terrorists in order to remove the threat they posed.
This follows a similar incident earlier in the day in the sector, in which the IAF struck a terrorist seen crossing the Yellow Line, posing an immediate threat to the troops.

item.title: Secret weddings exposed: Police raid community, 16 detained
item.description: Police raid Yavne'el community in crackdown on underage marriage, describing clandestine ceremonies held at secret locations with phones banned.

item.title: Health Ministry issues new screen-time rules for Israeli kids
item.description: From no screens before age 2 to social media only from 15, Israel’s Health Ministry unveils sweeping new recommendations for children and teens.

item.title: Eisenkot’s brave delusions
item.description: He calls the ‘Two-State Solution’ delusional - and then guarantees its fruition. Opinion.

item.title: Call of the Shofar
item.description: All the prophecies of the prophets are written in condensed form in this Torah portion. All the descriptions in the portion are, in fact, descriptions of the Mashiach.

item.title: Israel to release five Lebanese prisoners in US-brokered gesture
item.description: Israel to release five Lebanese POWs, following reported progress in talks over detainees, missing persons and the northern border.

item.title: Toronto rabbis spark backlash with burial ban over assisted dying
item.description: An Orthodox rabbis’ council has barred funerals and restricted burial for Jews who die through physician-assisted death, triggering a fierce backlash from other rabbis and community leaders.

item.title: Coming home is only the beginning
item.description: Nitzavim promises that G-d will bring us back. VaYelech tells Yehoshua that he must lead the people in taking possession of the Land - and that is in our hands.

item.title: Report: Iranian missiles hit Jordan hotel where US officers were staying
item.description: According to local Jordanian reports, the Iranian missiles fired earlier this week towards Jordan hit a hotel where US officers were staying.

item.title: Anti-Semitism in Spain surges
item.description: A new report found 221 anti-Semitic incidents in Spain in 2025, a nearly 15% increase from the previous year.

item.title: Deri: IDF can bomb Iran, it can handle haredi enlistment
item.description: Shas chairman Aryeh Deri says politicians should not call on haredim to enlist, claiming the IDF 'doesn’t really want' soldiers who listen to rabbis.

item.title: Katz to Iran: Attack Israel, we’ll send you back to the Stone Age
item.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz warns Tehran that any attack will risk devastating strikes on Iran’s military, civilian and energy infrastructure.

item.title: ‘Next round’ is coming: Houthis hold naval drills against Israel, US
item.description: Houthi official Mohammed Ali al-Houthi says naval drills in the Red Sea are preparations for the ‘next round’ of confrontation with Israel and the US.

item.title: IDF eliminates terrorist who crossed the Yellow Line in northern Gaza
item.description:
Earlier today (Thursday), IDF troops operating in the northern Gaza Strip identified a terrorist who crossed the Yellow Line and approached the troops in a manner that posed an immediate threat.
Following the identification, the Israeli Air Force struck the terrorist and eliminated him to remove the threat he posed.
